messages:
Hana (Product): Short thread to finalize the verifiability & export workflow for the enterprise compliance pilot. Need concrete acceptance criteria for next week's sign-off.
Irfan (Security): Core requirements: deterministic sampling for high-volume traces, tamper-evident export bundles, and clear BYOK wrap/unwrap semantics. Decide on HMAC vs signature for manifest.
Becky (Eng-Infra): Implementation note: hash-based sampling (hash(request_id, seed) % 100 < pct) is reproducible and cheap. We'll persist the daily seed and issuance event. Index on tenant+request_id+time is necessary for fast selective exports. Estimate: 2 sprints for index + export worker.
Chris (Solutions): Customers expect an offline verification flow for auditors: they should be able to validate bundle integrity and sampling reproducibility without our platform. That implies exported manifest contains sampling_seed, sampling_policy, checksums, and a platform signature.
Leah (Legal): From SOC2/ISO POV: deterministic sampling is acceptable if documented in contract and reproducible proofs are provided. Add key-rotation obligations: customers must notify us 7 days before KEK rotation for pilot onboarding.
AuditBot: Created TASK-42099: "verifiability-spec-and-demo" assigned to @Becky.
Irfan (Security): Recommendation: sign the manifest with ED25519 (compact, easy verifier libs) and include an HMAC over the manifest using the platform key for internal checks. For file encryption: AES-256-GCM. Also include `signature_key_id` in manifest.
Becky (Eng-Infra): Draft manifest fields (WIP): manifest_version, tenant, time_window, sampling_policy, sampling_seed, sampling_algorithm, wrapped_export_key, files:[...], checksums:[...], signature:ed25519:..., signature_key_id. We'll include a short verifier guide that shows how to recompute sampling via request_id+seed.
Chris (Solutions): Add a "replay test" artifact: a small signed proof that given a request_id you can deterministically show whether it was sampled. That helps auditors trust sampling.
Leah (Legal): I'll prepare a pilot addendum: default 90-day retention, optional paid archive tiers, deterministic sampling disclosure, export SLA (target <4h for 30/90 lanes), and key-rotation notification/escrow clauses.
Hana (Product): Proposed pilot acceptance checklist: (1) tenant policy API + Console UI for retention & sampling, (2) signed export bundle + verifier guide, (3) BYOK wrap/un-wrapping flow + rotation handling doc, (4) console cost estimator for retention lanes, (5) pilot with 2 regulated customers + auditor walkthrough.
Becky (Eng-Infra): Action items: TASK-42099 -> prototype manifest + export demo; I'll also provide infra ETA.
Irfan (Security): I'll write the short security spec for manifest signing and sampling reproducibility.
Chris (Solutions): I'll create the demo script and onboarding checklist for sales.
Leah (Legal): I'll draft the contract addendum and sampling wording.
Hana (Product): Great. If timelines slip, flag here. We'll publish the pilot one-pager after sign-off next Monday.
